address: 11815 Glass House Ln., Ste. 110, Orlando, FL, 32836, USA
bio: Set in O Town West, this contemporary spot blends Japanese kappo-style with Chef David Tsan's Taiwanese heritage. It is at once serious and playful, the kind of spot where a perfectly balanced Parmesan nigiri would not be out of place. Choose from the à la carte menu or ambitious tasting menus that span a kappo menu, omakase and others known as "experiences." Kick things off with charred Taiwanese-style cabbage, a bright crunchy dish finished with spicy tobanjan soy, crispy garlic and shallots. Be sure to try the excellent Yán Sū Jī, or Taiwanese popcorn chicken, with crispy fried chicken dusted with five spice seasoning, and the Tai Oroshini, a subtle, restrained dish featuring sea bream simmered in dashi broth with grated daikon.
